<a id="architecture"></a>

## Architecture

| Field | Value |
| --- | --- |
| principles | Hexagonal, functional core / imperative shell, constructor injection. core::prep owns every DTO and port; it has no I/O, Parquet, SQLite or engine dependency. Adapter crates implement PrepFold: pure, deterministic interpretation of supplied native input (JSONL records or a whole snapshot) into typed rows plus SessionFacts with a versioned checkpoint; no filesystem, clock or environment. Loaders implement PrepLoader: read-only discovery with skip accounting, stat, bounded reads to the last complete LF, prefix anchors, one-record reads at a native address. The SDK owns all prep semantics (root binding, change detection, generations, live tails, checkpoint compatibility, parallelism) and exposes fold_source, the single-source fold that prep, Plan 029 session status and external consumers share. output-prep implements PrepStore and is the only crate that knows Parquet/Arrow. The CLI turns argv into requests and renders reports; it holds no prep semantics. crates/app is the only composition root. No analytical engine is linked; research runs in external DuckDB over published Parquet. |
| composition_root | crates/app/src/main.rs dispatches; crates/app/src/prep.rs (new) holds the bindings table harness → {fold, loader}, resolves default roots from the adapter catalogue LocationHint (base + path) and HOME, merges explicit --root sets and opens ParquetPrepStore. Nothing else constructs concrete loaders, folds or stores. |
| contracts | core::prep (crates/core/src/prep.rs) is the single contract: PREP_TABLE_SCHEMA_VERSION = 2, PREP_CHECKPOINT_FORMAT = 1. No Parquet, Arrow, SQLite, engine, filesystem or clock dependency in core or sdk (arch-check)., Sources: PrepSourceKind {Append, Snapshot}. PrepSourceSet {harness, label, root: PathBuf}; label "default" is the catalogue root, explicit roots default to "root-&lt;first 8 hex of sha256(absolute root)&gt;" unless named. Source key = "&lt;harness&gt;/&lt;label&gt;/&lt;path relative to root&gt;" and is the stable key in every table. PrepSourceStat {path, file (relative), kind, identity, size, mtime_ns} (snapshot loaders fold SQLite -wal/-shm sidecars into size/mtime). PrepSkipCounts {symlinks, hidden, unreadable_entries}. PrepDiscovery {sources, skipped}. NativeAddress {offset: Option&lt;u64&gt;, key: Option&lt;String&gt;}., Rows (PrepRows {calls, turns, triggers, events, tool_uses}); every row starts (source, generation, native_offset: Option&lt;u64&gt;, native_key: Option&lt;String&gt;). Nullability is part of the contract: every timestamp (ts/ts_ms, started_ts/started_ts_ms), every token counter, model, ids and native address fields are Option so dialects without them (Cursor transcript, VS Code, legacy Copilot) emit explicit nulls; only source, generation, vocabulary columns, turn_no/next_turn_no, chars, records and is_sidechain are always present. calls: sighting first\|update, msg_id, request_id, ts, ts_ms, model, stop_reason (last non-null), input, cw_1h, cw_5m, cache_read, output, cache_write_basis (split\|fallback_1h\|fallback_5m\|none), is_sidechain, gap_ms, turn_no, call_in_turn, records. turns: turn_no, started_ts, started_ts_ms, first_call_offset, origin (reference-parser vocabulary: start\|human\|peer\|task-notification\|coordinator\|auto-continuation\|compact-summary\|manual-compact\|scheduled\|loop\|subagent-task\|other), sender, pij_msg_id, opener_offset, opener_ts_ms, opener_chars, body_key. triggers: ts, ts_ms, kind (same vocabulary as turns.origin), sender, pij_msg_id, chars, body_key, next_turn_no, content_head (only with include_content). events: ts, ts_ms, kind (compaction\|recap\|scheduled_fire\|limit_notice\|queue_op\|model_switch\|api_error\|system_other), subkind, trigger, model (model_switch: requested model), pre_tokens, post_tokens (native compact_boundary postTokens only), duration_ms, last_context, gap_ms, resets_at (native phrase), resets_at_ms (parsed only when the source allows), turn_no, body_key. tool_uses: sighting use\|result, tool_use_id, call_msg_id, name (native), family, input_hash, input_bytes, result_offset, result_bytes, outcome (ok\|error\|unknown), duration_ms (native only), turn_no. Unknown or unrecorded = null, never estimated., SessionFacts (core; the SDK-level contract Plan 029 session-status and Flowspace3 reuse without a target dir): session_id, parent_session_id, is_sidechain, cwd, first_event_ts/_ms and last_event_ts/_ms (latest native event timestamp, never mtime), records, calls, turns, latest_context: Option&lt;ContextSample {ts_ms?, model, stop_reason, input, cache_read, cache_write, total}&gt; (latest deduplicated main-chain call; sidechain calls excluded), compactions: Option&lt;CompactionCounts {manual, auto, unknown_trigger}&gt; (None only when the dialect has no native compaction marker), last_compaction: Option&lt;{ts_ms?, trigger, pre_tokens, post_tokens, first_context_after}&gt; (first_context_after = context of the first new main-chain call after the boundary, None until one exists), last_model_switch: Option&lt;{ts_ms?, requested_model}&gt;, seat_hint, skipped {malformed, untimed, bad_timestamp}. PrepSourceMeta {is_sub, agent_id, project} comes from PrepFold::describe(file), never from the store., trait PrepLoader: kind() -&gt; PrepSourceKind; discover(&self, root: &Path, accept: &dyn Fn(&str) -&gt; bool) -&gt; Result&lt;PrepDiscovery&gt;; stat(&self, root: &Path, path: &Path) -&gt; Result&lt;PrepSourceStat&gt;; read(&self, stat: &PrepSourceStat, from: Option&lt;&ReadCursor&gt;, limits: PrepReadLimits) -&gt; Result&lt;PrepBatch&gt;; anchor(&self, stat: &PrepSourceStat, offset: u64) -&gt; Result&lt;String&gt; (Append only; Snapshot returns Unsupported); record_at(&self, path: &Path, address: &NativeAddress, max_bytes: usize) -&gt; Result&lt;Vec&lt;u8&gt;&gt;. PrepBatch {input: PrepInput, next_cursor: Option&lt;ReadCursor&gt;, more, incomplete_tail, bytes_read}; PrepInput = Records(Vec&lt;NativeRecord&gt;) \| Snapshot(NativeSnapshot). Append reads stop at the last complete LF. Loaders open native stores read-only and never lock, rename or write them., trait PrepFold (pure, in adapter crates): harness() -&gt; &'static str; policy() -&gt; &'static str; kind() -&gt; PrepSourceKind; pattern() -&gt; &'static str (glob relative to the root); describe(&self, file: &str) -&gt; PrepSourceMeta; open(&self, meta: &PrepSourceMeta, source: &str (the source key stamped on rows), generation: u32, saved: Option&lt;&PrepCheckpoint&gt;) -&gt; Result&lt;Box&lt;dyn PrepFoldSession&gt;&gt;; a saved checkpoint with another policy or format is refused (InvalidData), never reinterpreted. trait PrepFoldSession: fold(&mut self, input: &PrepInput, options: PrepOptions) -&gt; Result&lt;PrepRows&gt;; checkpoint(&self) -&gt; PrepCheckpoint {format, policy, fold: serde_json::Value}; facts(&self) -&gt; SessionFacts. Equal (checkpoint, input, options) give equal output; folding a stream in any batch split, or resuming from a checkpoint, equals one uninterrupted fold., trait PrepStore: state(&self) -&gt; Result&lt;Option&lt;PrepState&gt;&gt; (read-only); load(&self) -&gt; Result&lt;PrepLoaded {state, orphans_removed}&gt; (recovers a crashed run); commit(&self, rows: &PrepRows, state: &PrepState) -&gt; Result&lt;PrepCommit&gt; (rows durable first, state published last by atomic rename); compact(&self) -&gt; Result&lt;PrepCompactReport&gt;. An implementation excludes concurrent writers for its lifetime. PrepState {table_schema_version, checkpoint_format, runs, parts, sets: BTreeMap&lt;set key, PrepSetState {harness, label, root, policy}&gt;, sources: BTreeMap&lt;source key, PrepSourceState {set, path, file, kind, identity, size, mtime_ns, offset, anchor, revision, generation, meta, checkpoint, facts, status}&gt;}., Outcomes (AC-0007 vocabulary): PrepSourceStatus = New \| Unchanged \| Appended \| Replaced {reason: Rotated\|Truncated\|Rewritten\|Revision\|Policy\|Schema\|RootMoved} \| Skipped (discovered but excluded by an explicit scope such as --modified-since; not read, committed state kept) \| Unreadable \| Unsupported (root of a harness with no binding) \| Missing (committed source no longer discovered; rows and state kept). Discovery-time exclusions (symlinks, hidden, unreadable entries) are PrepSkipCounts per set. Compatibility is per source: table schema + checkpoint format, set root, and checkpoint.policy vs the binding's policy. PrepReport {target, table_schema_version, run, sets: Vec&lt;PrepSetReport {harness, label, root, policy: Option (bindings' policies joined by '+'), supported, discovered, skipped: PrepSkipCounts, by_status}&gt;, bytes_read, pending_tail_bytes, rows_written: PrepTableCounts {calls, turns, triggers, events, tool_uses}, commit, sources: Vec&lt;PrepSourceOutcome&gt; (every source whose status is neither Unchanged nor Skipped)}., PrepApi (core; the CLI's only prep dependency): prep(&PrepRequest) -&gt; Result&lt;PrepReport&gt;; compact(&PrepCompactRequest {target}) -&gt; Result&lt;PrepCompactReport&gt;; record(&PrepRecordRequest {target, source, address, include_content, max_bytes}) -&gt; Result&lt;PrepRecord&gt;. PrepRequest {target, roots: Vec&lt;PrepSourceSet&gt;, options: PrepOptions {include_content}, limits: PrepReadLimits {read: ReadLimits, snapshot: SnapshotLimits}, threads, modified_since_ns}. record with include_content = false is refused (InvalidInput) before any native read., SDK (crates/sdk/src/prep.rs): Preparer::new(bindings: Vec&lt;PrepBinding {fold: Arc&lt;dyn PrepFold&gt;, loader: Arc&lt;dyn PrepLoader&gt;}&gt;, store: S) implements PrepApi; a root whose harness has no binding is reported supported = false with its sources Unsupported. fold_source(loader: &dyn PrepLoader, fold: &dyn PrepFold, stat: &PrepSourceStat, source: &str, generation: u32, resume: Option&lt;&PrepResume {cursor: ReadCursor, checkpoint}&gt;, options: PrepOptions, limits: PrepReadLimits, sink: &mut dyn FnMut(PrepRows)) -&gt; Result&lt;SourceFold {checkpoint, facts, cursor, anchor, revision, bytes_read, pending_tail_bytes, rows}&gt;; unisphere_sdk::prep re-exports core::prep is the single-source in-memory fold used by run_prep, Plan 029 and external consumers., Table contract (output-prep only): TARGET/state.json; TARGET/tables/{calls,turns,triggers,events,tool_uses}/*.parquet append-only parts; TARGET/tables/{sources,sessions}.parquet current snapshots; Parquet key-value metadata unisphere.table_schema_version; TARGET/views.sql (DuckDB) defining calls_v (current generation, grouped by (source, generation, msg_id, request_id) with per-field max, stop_reason last non-null), turns_v, triggers_v, events_v, compactions_v (with first_context_after), tool_uses_v (use+result merged), sources_v, sessions_v. Column names avoid SQL reserved words. Compaction rewrites current-generation rows only and changes no view result., CLI argv (frozen): unisphere prep --target DIR [--root HARNESS[:LABEL]=DIR]... [--harness H]... [--no-default-roots] [--include-content] [--max-record-bytes N] [--max-batch-bytes N] [--threads N] [--modified-since RFC3339] [--json\|--human]; unisphere prep compact --target DIR; unisphere prep record --target DIR --source KEY (--offset N \| --key K) --include-content. Phase 2 adds unisphere prep recipes [--json] and unisphere prep recipe NAME --target DIR (prints a self-contained DuckDB script; documented use: `unisphere prep recipe NAME --target DIR \| duckdb`). Exit 0 ok, 3 when any source is Unreadable, 2 usage, 1 error; envelope {ok, command, v, data, next_action} like existing verbs., Phase 2 adds folds and a snapshot loader against the same ports: a Snapshot source re-reads wholly on any stat change; equal NativeSnapshot.revision → Unchanged, otherwise a new generation. No phase-2 port change is planned; any required change is a PM contract delta sealed before phase-2 dispatch. |

<a id="fan-out"></a>

## Fan out

| Field | Value |
| --- | --- |
| decision | coders |
| rationale | Phase 1 splits into four behaviours that run and prove independently against the sealed v2 contract and testkit fakes: the Claude fold (pure, fixture-driven), the incremental engine (SDK + JSONL loader, driven by RecordingFold and MemoryPrepStore), the Parquet store (driven by synthetic PrepRows/PrepState) and the CLI frontend (driven by a fake PrepApi). The coupling that could force them together — state semantics shared by engine and store — is removed by freezing PrepState and the load/commit/compact protocol in the baseline. Integration (composition root, catalogue, proof mode, real-corpus parity) stays with the PM. Coders never import sibling implementations in the same wave. Phase 1 is delivered (units tk-0001…tk-0006, now PM-owned history). Phase 2 fans out seven independent lanes against the unchanged core::prep contract and the verified phase-1 composition: five pure fold lanes, one per adapter crate (each proves itself on synthetic fixtures through PrepFold/PrepFoldSession alone), the snapshot loader (proved on temp JSON/journal/SQLite files through PrepLoader alone) and the CLI lane (recipes, snapshot-limit flags, docs; proved against the published views contract and a fake PrepApi). The folds and the snapshot loader meet only in the PM composition root, which binds each representation fold to its loader by catalogue descriptor id. Builder composition takes one coder roster per frozen baseline, which is why this is guide v3 sealed on the phase-1 composition. |

| rk-0001 | Reference-parser semantics differ at window boundaries (prior-call state) and at 0.1 s gap-rounding ties; parity could be rounded away. | vd-000a reports every diverging field/row; divergences need reviewer acceptance. |
| rk-0002 | Fold checkpoints retain every committed call key; state.json grows with history and is rewritten per commit. | vd-000b reports state.json bytes and commit time on the full corpus. |
| rk-0003 | A same-size, same-mtime in-place rewrite is invisible to the stat fast path until the next growth. | vd-0003 pins detection at next growth by anchor; the prep docs topic states the limit. |
| rk-0004 | SQLite WAL growth can leave the main file's size/mtime unchanged; snapshot sources re-read wholly on change. | vd-0013 covers WAL-only growth; vd-000b reports snapshot bytes read. |
| rk-0005 | Two prep runs on one target could interleave parts and state. | vd-0004 proves the second writer is refused while the first holds the lock. |
| rk-0006 | Existing query mappings omit Codex model, VS Code and Cursor IDE usage; prep could inherit the gaps silently. | vd-000f, vd-0011 and vd-0012 assert values where the synthetic native record carries them and nulls where it does not. |
| rk-0007 | Recipes need an external DuckDB (installed here 2026-09-29 with Jordan's approval: brew duckdb 1.5.5); other machines may lack it. | research-recipes topic names the install; vd-000c runs every recipe through the documented pipe. |
| rk-000c | One Cursor IDE state.vscdb holds many composer sessions; per-source session facts describe the database, not each composer. | native_key carries the composer id; vd-0012 asserts it; documented in the prep topic. |
| rk-000d | Large snapshot stores (Cursor IDE, VS Code) can exceed default SnapshotLimits and become Unreadable. | Adjustable --max-snapshot-bytes/--max-snapshot-records (tk-000d); vd-0017 reports unreadable counts per harness. |
| rk-000e | Prep harness keys are catalogue descriptor ids (claude-code, oh-my-pi, copilot-cli-snapshot, cursor-ide, …), not the query harness ids; mixing them would split or collide sets. | crates/app/tests/prep.rs asserts the default sets by descriptor id; the prep topic documents the key. |
| rk-0008 | Phase-1 units stay in this guide as historical PM units whose paths overlap phase-2 lanes (sequential ownership, e.g. crates/cli/src/args.rs). | Overlap warnings are expected and advisory; phase-2 packets are sealed on the verified phase-1 composition. |
| rk-0009 | Flowspace3's wider observation seam (roles, text parts, request markers) is outside this plan's ACs; only fold_source, SessionFacts and the checkpoint are promised. | vd-0008 proves the external consumer path; the gap is stated in the prep topic. |
| rk-000a | Real prompts or identifiers could leak into fixtures or committed evidence. | Synthetic fixtures only; content columns null by default (vd-0002, vd-0005); proof scripts write only to .harness/temp and print numbers; reviewer inspects committed evidence. |
| rk-000b | Rows for a whole run are buffered before commit; memory could scale with corpus size. | vd-000b records peak RSS against the documented bound and the --threads / --max-batch-bytes controls. |
